page: Hetzner Cloud cpx52 is an x86_64 virtual instance hosted via the QEMU hypervisor, equipped with 12 shared AMD EPYC processor cores operating at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz. The CPU architecture provides 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates vector and cryptographic instruction sets including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The server is configured with 23.0 GB of system memory, yielding 1.95 GB per core, and includes 480 GB of local NVMe SSD storage without an integrated discrete GPU or complimentary IPv4 address.

Benchmark assessments highlight notable memory throughput and consistent compute capacity. Uncached memory bandwidth testing achieved read speeds of 220.50 GB/s and write speeds of 143.81 GB/s, corroborated by an upper-quartile PassMark memory score of 2,832.27. Processing capacity registered in the middle tier for multi-threaded loads, yielding a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,768.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 28,868.84. In lightweight inference evaluations, the configuration generated 304.2 tokens per second for a 135M model and 33.91 tokens per second for a 7B model. Web serving throughput reached 12.52 GB/s, while Redis SET operations achieved 32.74 million operations per second.

Because it relies on shared CPU scheduling, the instance carries the tradeoff of potential resource contention under dense neighbor multi-tenancy. Nonetheless, the high core density paired with high memory bandwidth and onboard NVMe storage provides qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound tasks with a roughly 1:2 memory-to-core profile. The platform is functionally suited for software compilation pipelines, static web delivery, batch compression, caching databases, and small to medium CPU-based language model inference.
description: Hetzner Cloud cpx52 is a compute-focused x86_64 virtual instance powered by 12 shared AMD EPYC cores operating at 2.0 GHz, paired with 23.0 GB of memory and 480 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Operating under QEMU, the processor features 32 MB of L3 cache along with AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware extensions. In benchmark assessments, the instance displays strong memory performance, attaining uncached large-block read speeds of 220.5 GB/s and write speeds of 143.81 GB/s. Computational metrics place it in the mid-range across multi-core workloads, delivering a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,768.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 28,868.84. Small and medium language model text generation achieves strong throughput, measuring 304.2 tokens per second for a 135M model and 33.91 tokens per second for a 7B model. With its 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio and high I/O throughput, cpx52 is suitable for software compilation, caching, batch data processing, and lightweight inference.
